description: This PHP class provides methods to verify Amazon SNS messages by validating message signatures, checking message topics, and verifying the signing certificate URL. It is used for SNS message validation and processing within the Goteo application.

classes.name: AmazonSns
classes.description: A class responsible for validating and verifying Amazon SNS messages, including signature validation and topic filtering within the Goteo PHP project.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies the authenticity of an SNS message by checking the topic, region, account, certificate URL, and message signature.

methods.name: endswith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified suffix; used internally for URL validation.
